principle: Precision-first abstaining gate. A case qualifies only when strict FDA-V3 makes APPROVED or CRL; REVIEW/NO_CALL never enters the 100-on-100 bucket.
note: Historical 100% is descriptive of the strict qualified subset, including documented predecision-evidence promotions under general rules; it is not proof of future 100% accuracy. Prospective performance remains unscored until qualified frozen cases receive FDA decisions.
